Natixis CIB Global Markets Institute – Investment Strategy Challenge 2026

Deadline: 20 Sep 2026
Location: Hong Kong

To Penultimate and Final Year UG Students,

 

Natixis CIB Global Markets Institute is inviting students graduating between December 2027 and December 2028 to join the “Investment Strategy Challenge 2026”. 

 

Interested students should form a team of 2 to 4 members and team leader should submit online application HEREby September 20, 2026 (Sunday).

 

For more details, please refer to the message and poster from the organiser below. 

 

==============================================
[Message from Natixis CIB Global Markets Institute]

 

Following the success of the Investment Strategy Challenge over the past few years, Natixis CIB is pleased to announce the return of the Global Markets Institute. Committed to nurturing young talent in the finance industry, the Institute provides a dynamic platform for diverse students to showcase their knowledge and creativity, effectively bridging the gap between classroom learning and real-world financial environments.   

This challenge provides an opportunity for students from diverse backgrounds to work in teams to discover Global Markets and connect with seasoned industry professionals. Students will form a team and customize a rule-based investment strategy for one of three hypothetical clients. The competition consists of two rounds – a written proposal and an onsite presentation. The champions will be fast-tracked for Natixis CIB’s 2027 Global Markets Summer Internship Program. 

For more details, you can view the event website here 

Eligibility for participation: 
   ●   Full-time students enrolled in Bachelor's or Master's Degree Programs at Universities in Hong Kong with an Expected Graduation Date between December 2027 and December 2028. 
   ●   Interested students should form a group of 2 – 4 members and submit applications online by 20th September 2026.  
   ●   Students from different universities can form the same group. 
 
Prizes: 
Champion: 
   ●   Fast-track to Natixis CIB's 2027 Global Markets Summer Internship Program 
   ●   HK$5,000 gift card 
   ●   Trophy 
   ●   Certificate  
  
First Runner-up: 
   ●   HK$3,000 gift card 
   ●   Trophy 
   ●   Certificate  
  
Second Runner-up: 
   ●   HK$2,000 gift card 
   ●   Trophy 
   ●   Certificate  
  
Finalists: 
   ●   Added to the Global Markets Summer Internship Program for potential future hiring* 
   ●   Certificate  

* Exceptional performers may also be invited to fast-track interviews for Natixis CIB's 2027 Global Markets Summer Internship Program
